interest: Covers Scandinavia's 1933-34 'ghost flier' scare, tied to Soviet espionage fears and far-fetched Japanese carrier theories off Norway.
overview: This file consists of Despatch No. 109 from Edward Albright, the United States Minister to Finland, dated February 14, 1934, reporting on widespread sightings of unidentified 'mystery airplanes' across northern Finland, northern Sweden, and northern Norway. The document details reports verified by civil and military authorities in Boden, Kemi, Suomussalmi, and Tromsø, governmental inquiries in the Swedish parliament, and military investigations launched by the Finnish Ministry of Defense. It evaluates contemporary rumors and press theories attributing the flights to Japanese reconnaissance from an aircraft carrier in the Norwegian Sea, Soviet reconnaissance or arms drops to Scandinavian communists, and narcotics smuggling rings, concluding with skeptical assessments by the Soviet Minister in Helsingfors and the Chief of the Finnish Coast Guard.

subfiles.about: Despatch reporting on investigations, official responses, and rumors surrounding sightings of 'mystery airplanes' across northern Finland, Sweden, and Norway.
subfiles.from: Edward Albright, U.S. Minister to Finland
subfiles.summary: U.S. Minister to Finland Edward Albright reports on persistent sightings over the preceding two months of mysterious night-flying monoplanes equipped with searchlights and navigation lights across northern Scandinavia and Finland. Military authorities, including Swedish forces at Boden and Finnish border patrols at Suomussalmi and Kemi, confirmed multiple sightings, prompting defensive precautions and inquiries in the Swedish parliament. Various theories circulating in the press blamed Japanese reconnaissance flights from a carrier off Norway, Soviet aerial reconnaissance or arms transport to communists, and international narcotics smugglers. Albright notes that these theories are undermined by the aircraft openly displaying lights, and cites skeptical comments from the Soviet Minister in Helsingfors and the Chief of the Finnish Coast Guard comparing the phenomenon to the Loch Ness monster.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 109 from Edward Albright (Helsingfors) on 'Mystery Airplanes' in Northern Finland and Scandinavia
